Chart.js 4.5.1 (UMD build)
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.js
Fetched: 2026-08-30
License: MIT (see https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/master/LICENSE.md)

Vendored locally (not loaded from a CDN at runtime) so the visualizer works
offline and makes no outbound network calls from the browser, consistent with
this project's confidential-data handling.
